artworks.title: Death of the Doe
artworks.medium: mezzotint on wove paper [proof before color]
artworks.dimensions: sheet: 39.7 × 49.4 cm (15 5/8 × 19 7/16 in.), trimmed within platemark
artworks.creditLine: Purchased as the Gift of the Krugman Family in Honor of J. Sylvia Krugman and Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The image depicts a man in a slightly crouched posture interacting with two dogs in a forest setting. The man has a rounded face and short, neatly styled hair. He is wearing a light-colored shirt with a necktie, pants, and a coat. A rifle is on the ground beside him. The background is filled with trees, foliage, plants, and rocks.

artworks.title: Wierd-Sisters; Ministers of Darkness; Minions of the Moon
artworks.medium: etching, engraving and aquatint printed in sepia on wove paper, with publisher's hand-coloring and inscriptions by Gillray
artworks.description: The image shows the profiles of three individuals positioned closely together, gazing ahead. Each person has distinct facial features. The first person has a prominent nose and wears a patterned shawl, the second person has delicate features with rosy cheeks and gray hair styled backward, while the third person has a long, slender nose and thick eyebrows, with voluminous, curly hair and a beard. They wear cloaks. The background features a cloudy, moonlit sky with a large moon visible in the distance. The scene is set at night.

artworks.title: Et vidi alium angelum fortem... (The Angel of the Apocalypse Appearing to Saint John)
artworks.creditLine: Anonymous in memory of Gaillard Ravenel
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a large, majestic winged figure emerging from clouds with a kneeling bearded figure extending a hand towards the first figure. The central figure is depicted with well-defined musculature and expansive wings, and the scene is set among dramatic clouds. At the lower right, the kneeling figure, dressed in draped garments, looks up with its hands clasped. The extensive use of shading and line work adds texture and volume, creating a dramatic interplay of light and shadow throughout the piece.

artworks.title: Judgment of Paris
artworks.description: The image shows two full-length figures and a cherub in a classical pastoral setting. The woman on the left is standing, with her body turned slightly towards the seated man. She has long, wavy hair that flows over her shoulder, and there is a chain of pearls or beads draped across her body. Her gaze is directed towards the man. She is partially covered with flowing drapery, and her hand rests gently on her chest. A small cherub with wings stands beside her, looking up and reaching towards her. The seated man has curly hair and is shirtless, wearing a cloth draped around his waist and sandals laced up his calves. He holds a shepherd's staff in one hand and extends his other hand towards the woman. The background features a large tree with an expansive canopy of leaves and a mountainous landscape visible in the distance.

artworks.title: David and Bathsehba
artworks.artist: Robert van Audenaerd, after Carlo Maratta
artworks.description: The image shows three women and one man in a classical setting. One nude woman sits in water holding an object, with long hair. Another woman stands beside her, holding a mirror reflecting the seated woman's face. The third woman sits at the fountain's edge, washing her raised leg, with an urn-like object nearby. Lush greenery and a building are in the background, with a man wearing a crown observing from a distant elevated position amidst trees.

artworks.title: Hebé
artworks.description: The image shows a person in a side profile, sitting and holding a jug in their left hand while pouring a liquid into a cup held in their right hand. The person has curly hair, detailed facial features, and is draped with a cloth. A large bird, potentially an eagle, is engaging with the cup. The background is plain.

artworks.title: La Méditation
artworks.artist: René Gaillard, after Johann Eleazar Schenau
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: The man is sitting on a bench in an attic room. He has long hair and a wrinkled face. He is wearing a coat, waistcoat, and knickerbockers, with laced shoes. His hands are clasped together on his lap, and he is looking out of a window. Next to him, there is a table with papers, a quill, an ink bottle, and scissors. On the floor, there is a pitcher and bowl, a basket of onions covered with a cloth, and a hat. The backdrop includes a bed with simple coverings and slanted walls. The window is open and there are drawings or notes pinned to the wall near it.

artworks.title: Martire de St. Pierre (The Martyrdom of Saint Peter)
artworks.dimensions: sheet: 47 × 30.7 cm (18 1/2 × 12 1/16 in.); trimmed within platemark with lower part of inscription trimmed off
artworks.description: This is a painting of a scene depicting a martyrdom with various figures in dynamic poses. The full-description of the image reveals a dramatic composition centered around a central figure positioned upside down on a cross, surrounded by other individuals in various active stances. Above them, celestial beings are visible, with one angel-like figure descending from the clouds bearing a laurel wreath. The background features a classical architectural structure. The clothing and poses suggest a historical or religious narrative, depicted with intense emotional expressions and physical movement.

artworks.title: Louis Boucherat, Chancelier, Garde des Sceaux de France
artworks.description: The image shows a bust-length portrait of a man within a decorative oval frame. The man is facing forward, with his torso slightly turned to the side but his head facing directly forward. He has long, curly hair, a prominent nose, and a composed expression. He wears a dark garment with a large square collar overlaid by a smaller inner garment with a pattern, and no visible jewelry. The background within the oval frame is shaded, while the outer border has a brick-like texture.

artworks.title: Susannah and the Elders
artworks.medium: etching, aquatint and drypoint on laid paper
artworks.description: This painting features three figures and a detailed setting. The composition centers on the figures under a canopy of trees. In the foreground, a seated figure is draped with a shawl on a stone, near a pair of slippers. The main focus is on two robed figures engaged with a partially clothed figure. The use of light and shadow enhances the drama and textures of the fabrics are intricately detailed. The scene is set against a dark, atmospheric background, reminiscent of Rembrandt's style.

artworks.title: Self-Portrait of Rembrandt
artworks.artist: Georg Friedrich Schmidt, after Rembrandt van Rijn
artworks.description: The image depicts an etching of a man from the waist up, facing forward. He has deep-set eyes, wavy grey hair, and a serious expression. He wears a wide-brimmed hat, a fur-trimmed coat, and a tunic with a textured pattern. He wears a chain with a medallion. The background is composed of fine cross-hatching.

artworks.title: Victor Hugo
artworks.medium: lithograph on chine collé on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a man in an upper-body portrait. He is seated and facing the viewer, with a composed expression. He has prominent facial features, including a straight nose and full lips. His hair is voluminous and wavy, brushed back. He is dressed in 19th-century attire, wearing a dark coat, waistcoat, white shirt, and a cravat. The chair he sits on is partially visible to the left. There is no visible jewelry or objects in his hands. The background is a softly shaded, plain backdrop.

artworks.title: Ruines de l'Hôtel de Brentonvilliers, à la pointe de l'île Saint-Louis
artworks.medium: etching on blue wove paper [proof before letters]
artworks.description: The image shows a scene with a riverside structure and an urban skyline in the distance. The horizon line is high, and a large building's dome stands out against the sky. There is a dam or floodgate on the left and a small boat by the river's edge. A stone wall with etching marks runs across the image, leading to a cluster of buildings with different rooftops. The artwork features cross-hatching and fine linework, creating texture and detail. The monochromatic palette uses dark ink and lighter areas for contrast. Wispy clouds are present in the lightly textured sky.

artworks.title: A Ruined Vault with a Vista of Saint Peter’s
artworks.creditLine: Purchased as the Gift of Vincent J. Buonanno
artworks.description: The image is an etching of an architectural interior view. The perspective is from a low vantage point, highlighting archways, columns, and a high vaulted ceiling. The scene emphasizes a massive structure enclosing the space, with archways leading to another building in the background. The brushstrokes create texture on the stone surfaces and shadows for depth. The color palette is monochromatic with shades of brown and black, capturing light and shadow. People are depicted small in scale.

artworks.title: Venus and Mars Served by Cupid and the Three Graces
artworks.creditLine: Ruth and Jacob Kainen Memorial Acquisition Fund
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a mythological banquet scene. The image features several figures in classical robes at a lavish feast. There are cherubic figures offering platters and holding shields. The central figure sits at a table with large platters and pitchers. The background includes fabric draping and classical columns. The scene is detailed with shading for depth.

artworks.title: André Hercules, Cardinal de Fleury
artworks.description: The image shows an elderly man seated in an elaborate chair. He is facing forward and has a broad nose, gentle expression, and subtle wrinkles. He has thin, shoulder-length white hair and is wearing ornate robes with fur trim. Behind him is a heavy drapery with a tie. To the left is a small table with books, an inkwell, and a quill. The background features a paneled wall. The subject is identified as André Hercule, Cardinal of Fleury in inscriptions at the bottom.

artworks.title: Apple Trees along the Side of a Ditch
artworks.description: The image shows a small body of water with grass-covered banks on either side. The viewpoint is slightly elevated, looking down at the scene. The horizon is in the upper third of the composition, separating the sky from the land. The artwork features intricate linework and stippling to create texture and detail, particularly in the tree branches. The color palette is monochrome, with shades of sepia and brown. A tree dominates the right side of the scene, leaning over the water. In the distance, more trees and fields are visible with minimal detail in the far background.

artworks.title: Bosidylle (Woodland Idyll)
artworks.medium: lithograph printed in green on chine collé
artworks.description: The image displays a landscape with dense woodland viewed from a low vantage point near the water. The horizon is obscured by trees and foliage. Tall, winding trees with intertwining branches dominate the scene. Detailed brushstrokes create texture in the trees and shrubbery. The color palette is muted and primarily green. Two birds are perched on a rock near us, reflected in the water. In the background, the forest continues with intricate details fading into the distance.

artworks.title: Burdock in Bloom
artworks.description: The image consists of large leaves and foliage in the center and front. The color palette is shades of gray. Delicate plants and tree trunks are visible in the background. All objects are centrally positioned in the rectangular frame against a blank margin.

artworks.title: Saint Francis of Assisi
artworks.medium: chiaroscuro woodcut printed in ochre and olive green from four blocks on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a man from the waist up, leaning diagonally against a large wooden cross. He is in a bent position, with his head slightly tilted to one side. His facial features are rugged and expressive, with a beard and a weary expression. His head is covered by a hood that is part of his long robe, which has a simple design and is tied at the waist with a cord. The robe covers his whole body, with the loose sleeves revealing his hands resting against the cross. To the side, there is a skull on a rock shelf. In the background, there are rocks and foliage.

artworks.title: The "Giardin Scuro," for Executions by Strangling
artworks.artist: Giovanni  De Pian, after Francesco Galimberti
artworks.medium: etching and aquatint on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a dimly lit, stone-walled room resembling a prison cell. There are four figures present. On the far right, a man is seated on a chair, bound at the wrists and ankles, looking up at a barred window. To the left are two men in long robes, one holding a crucifix. In the center left, there is a man in casual attire with a hat and tunic, wearing a belt with a sword or stick. Another figure is partially visible through a small doorway in the back wall. The room has a stark and somber atmosphere with rough bricks and shadows from the barred window. The floor is made of crudely cut stones or tiles.

artworks.title: The Holy Family
artworks.description: The image depicts three figures in a seated position. There is a woman holding a child on her lap, and an older man sitting behind them. The woman is turned slightly towards the child, lifting a piece of drapery with one hand while supporting the child with the other. She has styled, wavy hair and is dressed in flowing robes. The child appears to be a baby with curly hair. The older man has a long beard and is looking towards the child with an intent expression. The background is plain with subtle rocky surface details, and there is a halo-like circle around the woman's head. The number "1597" is inscribed in the bottom left corner of the image.

artworks.title: Programme de la représentation du 3 février 1878, salle Ventadour
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a theatrical poster or invitation with ornate illustrations. The central content of the image is a piece of paper or poster bearing text announcing a performance or event, surrounded by intricate illustrations. The drawing is likely created using etching or engraving techniques, as shown by the fine lines and detailed rendering of the figures and decorative elements. On either side of the central text, there are two figures dressed in historical clothing, one male and one female. In the background, there is a detailed scene depicting an outdoor gathering or market with several figures, along with buildings and trees. Large leaves or branches extend over the bottom of the image. The style suggests a historical or classical theme, rich in detail and intricacy.

artworks.title: Bust of Christ
artworks.medium: etching with engraving on laid paper, laid down
artworks.creditLine: Purchased as the Gift of Jimmy and Jessica Younger, Houston
artworks.description: The image shows a man with long hair and a beard, wearing a robe. He has a serene expression and his right hand is raised with an open palm. There is a halo-like circle around his head and an inscription below him that reads "IESVS CHRISTVS SALVATOR."
